title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: deep citations link to the cited part of Word and PowerPoint files
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and the documented SharePoint control, while keeping the default and feature-specific licensing open. One minor correction should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance about discovery of recently interacted files.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The control is at SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Sites and select Active sites. ... Select the site you want to configure. ... Open the Settings tab, and then turn Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot on.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true enables Restricted Content Discovery.
claims.quote: Enable Restricted Content Discovery for a site ... Use PowerShell ... Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery limits site-content discovery in organisation-wide search and Copilot discovery scenarios.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery affects organization-wide search experiences (SharePoint home, Office.com, Bing) and Microsoft Copilot discovery scenarios, including experiences that rely on tenant-wide content discovery.
claims.fix: Add to the existing control note: 'Microsoft guidance differs on recently interacted files: the Restricted Content Discovery page explicitly includes them, while the Copilot Search FAQ describes an exception for recent interaction.' Both pages are already cited: https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/restricted-content-discovery and https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-search-faq.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery does not affect experiences using content already in use, such as summarising an open document.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery doesn't affect experiences that operate on content that's already in use by the user, such as summarizing an open document.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery changes discoverability, not access permissions.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery affects discoverability, not access permissions. Users who already have access to content can continue to access it.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery lists a Microsoft Copilot licence as a prerequisite.

claims.where: Governance controls
